exposure: Human umbilical cord blood (UCB) mononuclear cell therapy
cohort: Chronically instrumented fetal sheep at 0.65 gestation were used in this experimental study.
finding: UCB cell therapy reduced cell death and inflammation, and restored total and mature oligodendrocytes in preterm fetal sheep brains following LPS-induced inflammation.
followup_time: 10 days after the first LPS dose
